bias.en: Rebound · SAR flipped bullish, above the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · SAR 翻多，站上 10 日均线

read.en: Coherent jumped 16.8% on Nov 9 to $225.19, trading $197.21–229.39 on heavy volume. It is above the falling 5-day ($198.1) and 10-day ($211.3) averages but below the falling 30-day ($254.5) and 100-day ($294.3) and the rising 200-day ($296.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, with the histogram nearly closed toward a cross; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Nov 9 ($160.23), and RSI is 47.
read.zh: Coherent 11月9日大涨 16.8%，收于 $225.19，盘中区间 $197.21–229.39，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$198.1）和 10 日均线（$211.3）上方，但仍低于下行的 30 日（$254.5）和 100 日均线（$294.3），以及上行的 200 日均线（$296.6）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图几乎收拢、接近金叉；抛物线 SAR 于 11月9日翻为看多（$160.23），RSI 为 47。

read.en: The surge cleared every prior resistance: the 5-day and Nov 2 low ($198.6), Oct 23 and Oct 30 lows ($203.6–203.9), the 10-day ($211.3) and the $220.7 Jul 29 low. Resistance is $229.4 (Nov 9 high), then $235.8–239.6 (Oct 27–29 closes) and $246.9 (Oct 29 high). Support is $220.7, then $211.3 and $203.6–203.9. A close above $229.4 would target $236–240; below $220.7, $211.
